title: Technical Content Writer
description:
**Company Description** 
 Ruddersoft delivers end\-to\-end Automatic Identification \& Data Collection (AIDC) applications and products, specializing in RFID, barcode solutions, and customized software development. The company supports end users with complete project lifecycles, from site assessment to deployment, and offers dedicated IT/RFID consultancy services. Ruddersoft focuses on SMART RFID\-based tracking and tracing solutions designed to improve visibility, accuracy, and operational efficiency. Applicants joining Ruddersoft will be part of a team developing innovative, technology\-driven solutions for real\-world data capture and automation challenges.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 The Technical Content Writer is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Ghaziabad. In this position, you will research AIDC, RFID, barcode, and related software topics and translate complex technical information into clear, accurate, and engaging content. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include writing product documentation, user guides, technical blog posts, case studies, website content, and marketing collateral that aligns with Ruddersoft’s solutions and brand voice. You will collaborate with engineers, product managers, and sales teams to gather information, ensure technical correctness, and maintain consistency across all content. The role also involves editing and proofreading materials, optimizing content structure, and contributing to content strategy for digital channels.
 



  





  





**Qualifications** 



* Strong technical writing and documentation skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts in clear, accessible language.
* Experience creating content for technology domains such as RFID, barcode systems, AIDC solutions, or enterprise software (blogs, white papers, product sheets, FAQs).
* Proficiency in editing and proofreading, ensuring accuracy, clarity, and consistency across all written materials.
* Familiarity with digital content practices, including basic SEO principles, web formatting, and collaboration with design or marketing teams.
* Ability to conduct structured research, interview subject matter experts, and synthesize technical information into well\-organized content.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with strong attention to detail and organization.
* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as Engineering, Computer Science, Technical Communication, English, Journalism, or a related discipline.
* Prior experience in a technical writing or technical content role within IT, software, or industrial automation is preferred.
* Comfort working on\-site in Ghaziabad, collaborating cross\-functionally, and managing multiple content projects and deadlines.

title: TECHNICAL CONTENT SPECIALIST – PHYSICS & ENGINEERING Research | Technical Editing | PowerPoint | Technical Graphics
description:
We are an 80\-year\-old U.S.\-based technical consulting firm. We are developing professional online courses and certificate programs in acoustics, noise and vibration control, applied physics, and related technical fields.
 



  





 We are seeking an experienced Technical Content Specialist to work directly with our senior technical experts. The experts will develop the technical course content; your role will be to research, edit, organize, illustrate, and professionally present that material.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Research technical topics using credible academic and professional sources.
* Edit technical content for clarity, consistency, grammar, and professional presentation.
* Develop high\-quality PowerPoint presentations from technical material provided by experts.
* Create and improve technical graphics, diagrams, illustrations, charts, and tables.
* Prepare and format course notes and supporting documents in Microsoft Word.
* Use Excel for calculations, charts, tables, and data presentation.
* Assist with examples, exercises, quizzes, references, and supporting course material.
* Use AI and modern productivity tools effectively for research, editing, graphics, and content preparation.
* Work directly with senior technical professionals through review and revision.



  





**Qualifications** 



* Bechler, master’s or higher degree in Physics or Applied Physics preferred. Mechanical Engineering, Acoustics, or closely related technical disciplines will also be considered.
* Minimum 5 years of relevant professional experience.
* Strong understanding of physics, particularly waves, frequency, energy, measurement, and basic mathematics.
* Excellent written and spoken English with strong technical editing ability.
* Highly proficient in Microsoft PowerPoint and Word, with good Excel skills.
* Strong technical research skills.
* Demonstrated ability to develop professional technical graphics and visual presentations.
* Ability to understand technical information and communicate it clearly without changing its technical meaning.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to work independently.



  





 Experience with Canva, Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, Figma, technical illustration, video editing, MATLAB Python, e\-learning, or AI\-assisted content tools is an advantage.
 



  





**Working Hours** 




 You will be working with Technical Expert based in US and often travels to different time zones. There the working schedule will be US Pacific time (India Nights) mainly along with adjustments to other time zones as required.
 



  





**Travel** 




 This is a Hybrid position, and Candidates must be willing to travel Jalandhar, Punjab, while the Technical Expert is in India.

title: Manager
description:
**Job Description:**
**About Us**
 At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. Responsible Growth is how we run our company and how we deliver for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
   

  

 One of the keys to driving Responsible Growth is being a great place to work for our teammates around the world. We’re devoted to being a diverse and inclusive workplace for everyone. We hire individuals with a broad range of backgrounds and experiences and invest heavily in our teammates and their families by offering competitive benefits to support their physical, emotional, and financial well\-being.
   

  

 Bank of America believes both in the importance of working together and offering flexibility to our employees. We use a multi\-faceted approach for flexibility, depending on the various roles in our organization.
   

  

 Working at Bank of America will give you a great career with opportunities to learn, grow and make an impact, along with the power to make a difference. Join us!
   

  

**Global Business Services**
 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
   

  

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
   

  

 In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Process Overview\***
 Global Finance was set up in 2007 as a part of the CFO Global Delivery strategy to provide offshore delivery to Line of Business and Enterprise Finance functions. The capabilities hosted include Accounts Payable, General Accounting \& Reconciliations, Management Reporting \& Analysis, Research \& Analytics, Financial Transaction Processing, Finance Systems Support \& Regulatory reporting. Over the years, the scope of Global Finance has been expanded to include operations for other enterprise control functions like Human Resources and Risk and Compliance.
   

  

 The CFOC (CFO Change) team, which is part of the COO \& Governance organization within CFO division, delivers finance projects and technology solutions for the Bank of America (BAC) enterprise and also supports Line of Business (LOB) projects that impact our core finance and general ledger applications. The CFO Change team is responsible for overall program/project management, business analysis and requirements, functional design, testing, organization readiness and deployment activities.
   

  

**Job Description\***
 This role is for a Business Analyst resource responsible for documenting detailed business requirements in support of the FCPS delivery of programs/projects in the US, EMEA, APAC and LATAM regulatory reporting groups and general ledger operations. The resource will be responsible for (1\) understanding the Change, (2\) defining and documenting the current state (if applicable) and target state processes and (3\) ensuring collaboration with Technology teams \& Users until implementation of the Change. It requires working closely with the Business Lead/Product Owner, including upstream / downstream Stakeholders and Technology to ensure all aspects of the change are being considered and prioritized when documenting the requirements. The business requirements are the foundation for the design, build, test, operational / organizational readiness, and deployment activities in the life cycle of a project.
   

  

**Responsibilities\***
* Understanding the Regulatory Change and documenting detailed requirements. This includes functional capabilities, workflow needs, business rules, reporting requirements and timelines, etc. Collaborate with the Users \& procure all required sign offs.
* Identifying current state processes and the target state scope, objective and business outcomes of the Program/Project
* Identifying any data sourcing requirements, documenting them and coordinating with relevant Teams
* Understanding the in\-house GRIFFIN \& AXIOM design and documenting functional specifications in conjunction to the business requirements
* Creating high quality JIRAs documenting all critical aspects including business requirements, mapping requirements, acceptance criteria, etc using the BAC enterprise change management templates
* Create process maps or operating model where necessary.
* Walkthrough of the requirements to Technology and participating in the sprint planning along with the Project Manager.
* Collaborating with the test teams to clearly set the expectations from a Quality or User Acceptance Testing perspective.
* Regression before every code release into production.
* Facilitate review sessions with Business, Technology \& Testing Teams where relevant.


**Requirements\***
**Education\***
 Graduate degree in Commerce, Business or Technology.
   

  

 Certifications If Any \- AXIOM / Business Analysis etc.
   

  

**Experience Range\***
 7 to 10 years
   

  

**Foundational skills\***
* Experience as a Functional Business Analyst in technology implementation projects, having written Business requirement documents (BRDs)
* Extremely strong Knowledge of EMEA regulatory reports (COREP, Finrep, AnaCredit, ESG etc..) and Strong knowledge of financial concepts
* Ability to understand complex business processes and breakdown to process components.
* Demonstrate ability to work in a fast\-paced, every\-changing, highly collaborative environment.
* Strong knowledge of creating process maps
* Strong relationship management and interpersonal skills, ability to build strong rapport, respect and trust with key stakeholders and constituents.
* Professional written and verbal communication skills
* Excellent analytical skills and ability to identify/raise questions, and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, and good with numbers
* Proficient with Microsoft Office products (particularly MS Excel, Word, Visio, PowerPoint)


**Desired Skills**
* Exposure to projects in Financial Accounting and reporting (in Financial Control / Product Control/Treasury), and/or in Risk Regulatory reporting (Market or Counterparty risk) in financial services industry
* Expertise in Axiom Regulatory platform (if possible, AXIOM certified)
* Knowledge of Banking and Capital market products
* Understanding of automation tools like Alteryx, Tableau, Power BI
* Knowledge/ Experience with Copilot/ Other AI tools usage in day\-to\-day BAU processes
* SQL, Database knowledge \& ability to analyze data and related flows
* Knowledge of Agile methodology and tools (i.e., JIRA)


**Work Timings\***
 11:30 am to 8:30 pm
   

  

**Job Location\***
 Gurugram/Mumbai

title: Manager Events and Executive Client Engagement
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start
 **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**
 The Channel Specialist \- Events \& Executive Client Engagement is the execution backbone for priority events and executive interactions. Reporting to the offshore Channel Lead \- Events \& Executive Client Engagement, this role produces, governs, and readies all event and executive\-facing assets, ensuring accuracy, compliance, accessibility, and reuse across conferences, client summits, advisory boards, and virtual programs. The Specialist operates primarily asynchronously with structured overlap for reviews and approvals, enabling US on\-ground teams to deliver high\-impact, measurable experiences.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
* Execute the event content plan by developing and managing brochures, one\-pagers, booth screens, session slides, demo narratives, videos, and digital assets for in\-person and virtual events
* Build and maintain content toolkits (templates, modules, messaging snippets) with metadata, tagging, and version control to enable efficient reuse and consistency
* Support executive client engagement materials (briefing books, tailored case studies, follow\-up emails) and coordinate approvals with brand, legal, and compliance
* Partner with creative teams and agencies on copy, design, video edits, and motion assets, ensuring brand consistency, accessibility, and quality standards
* Coordinate logistics inputs for content (specs, deadlines, run\-of\-show, print/digital delivery) and own checklists/QA to ensure assets are show\-ready
* Use AI tools to draft abstracts, session descriptions, recap summaries, and asset variants within established governance; apply human review to ensure accuracy and compliance
* Track engagement metrics (asset downloads, QR scans, session attendance, booth interactions) and prepare clean reports/insight summaries for optimization
* Maintain audit trails and documentation required for regulatory compliance and internal governance processes
* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re\-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so


**Required Qualifications**
* Overall, 8\+ years of experience with 7\+ years of experience in event content production, marketing communications, sales enablement, or related roles within complex/regulated environments
* Hands\-on proficiency with presentation tools (e.g., PowerPoint), event platforms, digital asset management, and basic video workflows
* Familiarity with AI\-assisted content creation and comfort adopting new tools and standardized workflows
* Demonstrated solid writing and editing skills with attention to detail for accuracy, accessibility (e.g., alt text, contrast), and brand voice
* Demonstrated solid project management and collaboration skills; ability to manage multiple events, stakeholders, and deadlines simultaneously


*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone\-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income\-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes \- an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*
 \#NJP

title: Specialist, Oracle HCM
description:
**Make your mark with Thiess** 





 Every day, all around the world, Thiess supports and celebrates our people. We recognise talent, reward transparency, champion diversity and embrace change.
 



 Join us and hone your skills and develop new ones. Take on big challenges and grow through mentorship, collaboration, and empowerment.
 








**The Opportunity** 





 As Oracle HCM Application Specialist within the People Systems team, you will support and enhance Thiess's HR systems and technology landscape, applying strong technical and functional expertise in Oracle HCM Cloud configuration, integrations, and data management to deliver reliable system solutions and process efficiencies that improve the employee and leader experience across the business globally.
 




**Reporting to the Manager, People Systems, you will provide timely, high\-quality technical support to the HR team and broader business, including the scoping, implementation, and optimisation of HR systems projects to ensure accurate, consistent, and efficient outcomes.** 










**As the \[Position Title], you will:** 





**Operational BAU Support** 




 • Act as the first and second point of contact for Oracle HCM issues raised by the global workforce through the ticketing system.
   

 • Be the HR domain expert and HCM functional specialist for the implemented modules including Core HR, Talent, Performance, Goals,
 



**Recruitment, Onboarding and Compensation \& Benefits.** 




  

 • Support strategy and roadmap formulation for Oracle HCM and other HR systems, supporting the Manager, People Systems.
   

 • Triage, investigate, and resolve incidents and service requests within agreed service levels.
   

 • Provide ongoing L2/L3 functional and technical support for production issues, service requests, and change requests, ensuring SLA\-driven system stability.
   

 • Make system configuration changes, correct data, and troubleshoot issues across HCM modules.
   

 • Keep clear records of resolutions, configurations, and known issues.
   

 • Escalate complex issues to Oracle Support or implementation partners (CIMIC / Oracle / WIPRO) where needed.
 



**Projects** 




 • Own end\-to\-end delivery of HCM rollout projects, from requirements and solution design through configuration, data migration, cutover, and hypercare support.
   

 • Support the rollout of Oracle HCM across different geographies, and Thiess businesses working with regional HR, Payroll, and IT stakeholders.
   

 • Define integration requirements between Oracle HCM and other systems, and resolve integration issues.
   

 • Take part in fit\-gap analysis and recommend target\-state design and process improvements.
   

 • Present project updates, steering committee papers, and post\-implementation reviews to leadership.
 



**Enhancements** 




 • Identify opportunities to improve systems and processes based on user feedback and recurring trends.
   

 • Support the design, testing, and roll\-out of new features, functionality, and quarterly Oracle updates.
   

 • Drive continuous HCM optimisation and automation of operational tasks and reporting.
   

 • Build and maintain reports and dashboards using BI Publisher and OTBI for actionable HR insights.
   

 • Support change impact assessment and user communication or training for new enhancements.
   

 Commercial \& Stakeholder Relationships • Look for cost efficiencies where possible, without compromising safety.
   

 • Engage others by focusing on common ground and shared objectives.
   

 • Consult with stakeholders before making decisions.
 



**People \& Leadership** 




 • Work towards plans to achieve team and business goals.
   

 • Support others to deliver results and improvements.
   

 • Coordinate effectively across teams and manage issues, conflict, and problems as they arise.
   

 • Build collaborative relationships with global HR functions.
   

 Health, Safety \& Sustainability • Understand the critical risks in your area and reassess hazards if the work area changes.
   

 • Know and apply the standards and procedures relevant to your role. Stop the job if in doubt, fix the problem, or warn others of danger.
 








**About you** 





**Formal Education** 




 • Bachelor's and/ or master's degree in technology, Human Resources, or a related field preferred.
   

 • Oracle HCM Cloud certification(s) advantageous.
 



**Work Experience** 




 • 3\+ years' experience working with Oracle HCM / Fusion.
   

 • In\-depth experience with Oracle HCM modules including Core HR, Talent, Performance, Goals, Recruitment, Onboarding and Compensation \& Benefits.
   

 • Experience supporting or delivering Oracle HCM Cloud implementation projects, ideally across multiple countries spread across diverse businesses.
 



**Technical Skills** 




 • Strong domain knowledge of HR, Payroll, Time \& Attendance and Talent management processes is a must
   

 • Strong technical and functional knowledge of Oracle HCM Cloud, including configuration, integrations, and data management.
   

 • Confident troubleshooting skills, able to diagnose and resolve issues efficiently within a ticketing environment.
   

 • Understanding of system integrations (e.g., middleware, third\-party HR platforms) and data governance principles.
   

 • Able to translate business requirements into practical, scalable system solutions.
   

 • Proficient in MS PowerPoint, Word and Excel.
   

 • Well\-developed written and oral communication, with excellent attention to detail.
   

 • Comfortable working with stakeholders across Mining Operations, HR, Payroll, IT, Finance and business leadership in different regions and time zones.
   

 • Strong understanding of HR processes and associated workflows.
 




**What's on offer** 





 At Thiess, our people are the heart of everything we do. We're committed to creating a workplace where everyone can thrive \- safely, confidently and with opportunities to grow.
 


* Competitive salary package.
* Ongoing training \& development opportunities.
* A strong safety\-first culture across all operations, built on care, respect and accountability.
* Range of corporate discounts including health insurance (Medibank), travel \& retail products.







**About Thiess** 

 Thiess works with clients in Australia, Asia and the Americas in the dynamic field of open\-cut and underground mining.The pioneering spirit of our founders \- the legendary Thiess brothers \- is our legacy and inspires our vision to harness the power of people and technology to drive sustainable change. At Thiess, you will have the opportunity to play a part in the global energy transition. We are growing our commodities portfolio to include metals and minerals critical to the energy transition and developing services to enable sustainable mining.We’re creating a culture of curiosity, knowledge\-sharing, and continuous learning \- supporting our people to contribute to Thiess’ success and continued growth in sustainable mining. We’ll support you in honing your skills and developing new ones, taking on challenges and growing through mentorship, collaboration, and empowerment. We offer our people ongoing technical training and development opportunities so they can reach their full potential. We also invest in the workforce of the future, with a range of programs for people starting their careers. We recognise the value of an inclusive and diverse workplace through our vision of everyone matters always. We’re focused on creating an inclusive environment to enable our people to bring their best self to work because they feel safe, included and empowered.
 **About Capability Hubs**
 Thiess’ Capability Hubs are a key part of how we deliver work globally \- connecting skilled talent with business needs to provide high\-quality, efficient, and scalable services across functions and regions. The Capability Hubs enable access to global capability, supporting business growth while strengthening consistency, performance, and value delivery across Thiess. Our Capability Hubs operate as an integrated extension of the business, working in close partnership with Service Recipients to deliver outcomes that matter. With a strong focus on service discipline, governance, and continuous improvement, the Hubs play a critical role in how Thiess operates and evolves.
 **Make your mark \- Globally, People First**
 Our Capability Hubs offer the opportunity to make your mark as part of a global business, collaborating across diverse teams to connect global capability with local delivery. You will contribute to shared success while building valuable professional experience in a supportive and respectful environment where your contribution is rewarded, and your wellbeing is valued. This experience is underpinned by four key pillars \- Global Connection, Meaningful Contribution, Career Opportunities, and a Values\-led Culture \- which define what it means to work within our Capability Hubs. You will work globally with diverse teams, broadening your perspective and deepening your expertise, while contributing to meaningful outcomes that deliver value to the business. You will also build practical experience and capability to support your ongoing career growth, within a values\-led culture where people are respected, supported, and recognised for their contribution.

title: Integrated Logistics Customer Onboarding - Engineer
description:
**It's more than a job**
 As a member of the Freight Forwarding team Kuehne\+Nagel, you will play a key role in transporting goods, optimising processes, and fulfilling our customers' promises. description:
**Company Description** 
 Amber Electrotech Ltd, founded in 1958 as an electrical contracting agency, has grown into a comprehensive turnkey solution provider for a wide range of electrical projects. The company delivers internal and external electrification and substation services, including high\-end and conventional solutions, and has expanded to a business of approximately $20 million. With a passionate team of engineers, Amber Electrotech focuses on providing best\-in\-class electrical services at competitive prices while consistently exceeding customer expectations. As a diversified turnkey provider, the company offers electrical techno\-commercial solutions and is equipped to manage stringent S.I.T.C requirements and related clearances from relevant electrical authorities.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site MEP Tendering role based in Okhla. The role involves preparing and reviewing tender documents, BOQs, and cost estimates for MEP (Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing) projects, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and alignment with client specifications. The MEP Tendering professional will coordinate with engineering, procurement, and project teams to gather technical inputs, clarify scope, and optimize pricing and solutions. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include analyzing drawings and specifications, obtaining vendor quotations, preparing techno\-commercial offers, and supporting negotiations and bid submissions. The role also includes maintaining tender documentation, tracking deadlines, and contributing to continuous improvement of tendering processes and templates.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Strong knowledge of MEP systems, including electrical distribution, HVAC, plumbing, and related building services.
* Experience in tendering, estimation, and BOQ preparation for MEP or electrical turnkey projects.
* Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, specifications, and standards.
* Proficiency with MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and familiarity with estimation or project management software.
* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Electrical, Mechanical, or related Engineering discipline.
* Excellent analytical, numerical, and problem\-solving skills, with attention to detail and accuracy.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills for working with cross\-functional teams, vendors, and clients.
* Prior experience in contracting or turnkey solution companies, especially in S.I.T.C projects, is an advantage.
* Ability to work on\-site in Okhla and manage multiple tenders and deadlines simultaneously.

title: Computer Engineering
description:
**Computer Engineering — AI Data Trainer**
**About The Role**
 We're looking for computer engineering experts to help train and improve the next generation of AI models. At Alignerr, we partner with the world's leading AI research labs — and your deep technical knowledge is exactly what's needed to make these systems smarter, more accurate, and more reliable.
   

  

 You'll stress\-test advanced language models on complex hardware and systems topics, expose their failure modes, and help build the ground\-truth solutions that shape how AI reasons about computer engineering.
   

  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week


**What You'll Do**
* Design Challenging Problems — Create advanced computer engineering scenarios spanning RISC\-V/ARM architecture, FPGA development, memory management, hardware\-software co\-design, embedded systems, and more
* Author Gold\-Standard Solutions — Write rigorous, step\-by\-step technical solutions including assembly code, HDL snippets, and architectural diagrams that serve as benchmarks for AI training
* Audit AI Outputs — Evaluate AI\-generated code (C/C\+\+, Verilog, VHDL), logic gate designs, and OS kernel implementations for technical accuracy, efficiency, and standards compliance
* Improve AI Reasoning — Identify flaws in AI\-generated reasoning — such as race conditions, memory leaks, or timing constraint violations — and provide structured feedback to improve model performance


**Who You Are**

 At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
   

  

**Global Business Services**
 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
   

  

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
   

  

 In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Process Overview\***
 Global Finance was set up in 2007 as a part of the CFO Global Delivery strategy to provide offshore delivery to Line of Business and Enterprise Finance functions. The capabilities hosted include Accounts Payable, General Accounting \& Reconciliations, Management Reporting \& Analysis, Research \& Analytics, Financial Transaction Processing, Finance Systems Support \& Regulatory reporting. Over the years, the scope of Global Finance has been expanded to include operations for other enterprise control functions like Human Resources and Risk and Compliance.
   

  

 The FCPS (Finance Change and Production Services) team, which is part of the (GFC) Global Financial Control organization within CFO division, delivers finance projects and technology solutions for the Bank of America (BAC) enterprise and also supports Line of Business (LOB) projects that impact our core finance and general ledger applications. The Finance Change team is responsible for overall program/project management, business analysis and requirements, functional design, testing, organization readiness and deployment activities. The Production Services function ensures all financial accounting \& regulatory reporting systems and applications are operating smoothly from a functional perspective.
   

  

**Job Description\***
 This role is for a Business Analyst resource responsible for documenting detailed business requirements in support of the FCPS delivery of programs/projects in the US, EMEA, APAC and LATAM regulatory reporting groups and general ledger operations. The resource will be responsible for (1\) understanding the Change, (2\) defining and documenting the current state (if applicable) and target state processes and (3\) ensuring collaboration with Technology teams \& Users until implementation of the Change. It requires working closely with the Business Lead/Product Owner, including upstream / downstream Stakeholders and Technology to ensure all aspects of the change are being considered and prioritized when documenting the requirements. The business requirements are the foundation for the design, build, test, operational / organizational readiness, and deployment activities in the life cycle of a project.
   

  

**Responsibilities\***
* Understanding the Regulatory Change and documenting detailed requirements. This includes functional capabilities, workflow needs, business rules, reporting requirements and timelines, etc. Collaborate with the Users \& procure all required sign offs.
* Identifying current state processes and the target state scope, objective and business outcomes of the Program/Project
* Identifying any data sourcing requirements, documenting them and coordinating with relevant Teams
* Understanding the in\-house GRIFFIN \& AXIOM design and documenting functional specifications in conjunction to the business requirements
* Creating high quality JIRAs documenting all critical aspects including business requirements, mapping requirements, acceptance criteria, etc using the BAC enterprise change management templates
* Create process maps or operating model where necessary.
* Walkthrough of the requirements to Technology and participating in the sprint planning along with the Project Manager.
* Collaborating with the test teams to clearly set the expectations from a Quality or User Acceptance Testing perspective.
* Regression before every code release into production.
* Facilitate review sessions with Business, Technology \& Testing Teams where relevant.


**Requirements\***
**Education\***
 Graduate degree in Commerce, Business or Technology.

**Experience Range\***
 11 to 13\+ years
   

  

**Foundational skills\***
* Experience as a Functional Business Analyst in technology implementation projects, having written Business requirement documents (BRDs)
* Extremely strong Knowledge of EMEA regulatory reports (COREP, Finrep, AnaCredit, ESG etc..) and Strong knowledge of financial concepts

****The role in one line****
 This is not a "manage the website" role or a CRO role for its own sake — it's a lead\-generation role that uses the website as the primary lever. You own the website end to end — from a raw idea for a page to a shipped, converting landing page — against one defined outcome: 35–50 MQLs a month generated organically from the website and the motions around it.
   

  

****Why this role exists****
 Most people who "manage the website" either write copy and hand it to a designer, or build pages and wait for someone else to tell them what to put on them. We need someone who does both halves in one head: knows what a page needs to say because they've done the research and talked to customers, and knows why a page converts or doesn't because they think like a CRO person, not just a writer or a builder. The output is a live, working page — not a doc that someone else has to translate.
   

  

******What You'll Own******
* The website as a whole — structure, page inventory, and how it evolves as the company's positioning evolves.
* Idea → live page. You take a rough brief ("we need a page for X service" or "we're repositioning around Y") and turn it into a wireframe, then real copy, then a shipped page — working with a designer where needed, but driving the thing yourself.
* Conversion performance — what's converting, what isn't, and why. You run the experiments, not just report the numbers.
* Lead capture and funnel logic on\-site — forms, CTAs, gating, the path from a visitor landing on a page to becoming a lead in HubSpot.
* The lead number. 35–50 organic leads/month from the website and the motions around it (SEO, AEO, on\-site conversion, content) is your number. The page isn't done when it ships — it's done when it's producing.


****What you'll actually do, week to week****
* Talk to customers and internal stakeholders (sales, delivery, leadership) to figure out what a page actually needs to say to move a buyer — not guess at it from a template.
* Look at signals — search intent, competitor positioning, what prospects ask sales, what's converting elsewhere — and turn them into a point of view on what the page should be.
* Write the copy yourself. This isn't a hand\-off role — strong, clear, buyer\-facing writing is a core skill here, not a nice\-to\-have.
* Sketch wireframes and work directly with a designer (or design tools yourself) to get from idea to a real, live example fast.
* Build and manage pages in WordPress and HubSpot CMS.
* Use AI tools (Claude and others) and Figma as part of your everyday workflow — for research, drafting, quick mockups, and design iteration.
* Structure pages and content for both traditional SEO and AEO (answer engine optimization) — so the site shows up in Google and gets cited by AI answer engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and AI Overviews.
* Track what's converting and what's not, and keep iterating rather than treating a page as "done" once it ships.


****What we need****
* A CRO brain. You should be able to look at a page and say, with reasons, why it will or won't convert — and know how to fix it. This means understanding funnels, lead capture mechanics, and what actually moves a B2B buyer to act.
* Strong writing, in service of strategy. You can write clean, persuasive copy, but more importantly you know what needs to be said and why, before you write a word.
* A founder/CMO\-level eye for B2B design. You don't need to be the designer, but you need the taste to know what good B2B design looks like and the ability to brief and push back on one.
* The ability to simplify. You can take a genuinely complex service or technical concept (a RevOps build, an AI GTM agent) and explain it in language a buyer actually understands.
* A working understanding of AEO and SEO. You know how to structure and write content so it ranks in search and gets picked up and cited by AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews) — this isn't optional anymore for a website role.
* Strong writing skills paired with AI fluency. You write well yourself, and you use AI tools to move fast — generating quick mockups, drafts, and iterations rather than waiting on a full design cycle for every idea.
* Comfort with the tools: WordPress, HubSpot CMS, Figma, and AI tools (Claude and similar) as part of daily work.
* Ownership instinct — you treat the website as yours, not as a queue of tickets from other teams.
* 4–5 years of experience working on websites/landing pages, ideally with direct exposure to conversion work, not just content or design in isolation.


****What's in it for you****
* Ownership, not a task list. We don't hand you a checklist and check boxes. Direction and context get discussed openly, and then the "how" — the wireframe, the copy, the page — is yours to run with.
* A performance\-driven culture. Speed and conversion results define your trajectory here, not tenure or face\-time. Ship fast, see what moves the numbers, and get rewarded for it.
* Access to the top of the market. The pages you build speak to CMOs, VPs of Sales, and founders across the B2B US market — real high\-stakes work, not busywork nobody reads.


****How we'll know this is working****
 Within a quarter: organic leads from the website and its motions are trending toward the 35–50/month range, pages you've shipped are outperforming what existed before on conversion, sales and leadership are coming to you first when a new page or repositioning is needed, and the website stops feeling like a static asset and starts feeling like something that's actively working for the business.
   

  

******Who You'll Work With******
 Reports into growth/marketing leadership at OneMetric, works closely with sales, delivery leads, and a designer (in\-house or external) to take ideas from brief to live page.
   

  

******Who You'll Work With******
 This role reports to the CEO’s office at OneMetric and works closely with sales and delivery leaders on HubSpot implementation, RevOps, and GTM projects.

title: Senior Analyst - BCG Vantage
description:
Who We Are
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.
   

  

 To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 As a Senior Analyst within BCG's Travel Cities and Infrastructure (TCI) and Capital Projects Excellence (CPEx) Practice Areas (PAs), you will work in a growing global team, delivering value to clients via individual expertise and/or institutionalized tools (digital products, methodologies, knowledge, data, workshops, frameworks, surveys, domain\-specific data, and related expertise, etc.).
   

  

 You will be part of BCG Vantage, a network of experienced consultants who leverage deep domain expertise to deliver insight for case teams and clients. Vantage members are affiliated with BCG Practice Areas, plugged into the strategic agenda, and build and deploy leading\-edge IP, data, and tools to support that work.
   

  

 You will contribute to cases and proposals by developing relevant analysis and insights for clients, and support business development and go\-to\-market efforts for both PAs through research and marketing analysis as opportunities arise. This includes travel to client sites during staffing assignments to understand requirements and design/develop solutions.
   

  

 You will support cases, business development, and commercialization efforts, working alongside business leaders, through activities such as:
   

  

 Leading process improvement initiatives in Capital Projects.
   

  

 Creating capital portfolio governance strategies.
   

  

 Analyzing and optimizing engineering processes for greater efficiency and quality.
   

  

 Implementing process standardization and continuous improvement methodologies.
   

  

 Collaborating with engineering and construction teams to ensure process alignment with business goals.
   

  

 Monitoring process performance metrics and implementing corrective actions as needed.
   

  

 What You'll Bring
   

  

* 1\-2\+ years of consulting experience in construction, engineering, process improvement or implementation related field strongly preferred, ideally including a role with an EPC, General contractor or Project Management Consultancy (PMC) — e.g., site supervision, procurement review or vendor coordination
* In lieu of consulting experience, 2\+ years minimum relevant industry experience required; 3\-6\+ years of industry experience strongly preferred
* Bachelor's Degree required (advanced degree preferred) in a relevant field such as engineering or industrial management
* Strong experience with construction and engineering process management and improvement, including working knowledge of civil/structural drawings, BOQs, project controls, scheduling and site documentation
* Experience with cost control, scheduling, risk management and field operations
* Analytical and data driven skills
* Fluency in English
* Strong business acumen and problem\-solving capabilities
* Strong written and verbal communication skills


 Who You'll Work With
   

  

 As a SA, you will work face to face with clients and with BCG Project Leaders, Associates and Consultants. In the period between cases, you will collaborate with global topic leads and colleagues across BCG to bring expertise and capabilities to the service of our internal and external clients. Our team is made up a diverse pool of industry experts that allow us to pursue exciting, innovative consulting careers.
   

  

 Additional info
   

  

**YOU'RE GOOD AT**
* Analytical thinking and problem\-solving, particularly related to infrastructure and making capital projects effective and efficient.
* Communicating with case teams and clients team members, in a credible and confident way
* Stakeholder engagement and communication
* Structured yet pragmatic and agile approach to task and project management.
* Organizational tasks and data analysis, with a keen understanding of how to distil data insights and translate them into action.
* Being a proactive team player with effective communication skills, showcasing practical efficiency over theoretical knowledge.
* Working collaboratively and effectively in a group dynamic, in\-person or virtually; proficient in agile ways of working.
* Being flexible and bringing a curious and creative mindset, open to new things and able to propose innovative ideas.
* Navigating complexity and ambiguity


 At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in\-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.
   

  

 For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.
   

  

 We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

We're dedicated to equality, and we encourage applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow.

 BCA / MCA / B.Tech / BE or equivalent technology degree
 



  





**About SkillsNCR** 




**SkillsNCR is building practical, industry\-oriented learning programs and technology\-enabled solutions designed to help students and recent graduates become workplace\-ready.** 




**We are looking for a Graduate Trainee – Technology \& Solutions** 
 who can grow with us across technology development, product support, data, AI, databases and technical learning.
 



 This is not purely a teaching role.
 



  





 You will be expected to:
 



**Learn → Build → Test → Support → Explain** 




**You may work on SkillsNCR's internal platforms, student\-facing applications, assessments, automation, data systems, AI\-enabled solutions and technical learning programs.** 




**You are not expected to know everything on Day 1\. We are looking for someone with strong fundamentals, curiosity, ownership and the ability to learn quickly.** 




  





**What You Will Work On** 




**Depending on your strengths and business requirements, you may work across:** 



* SQL and databases
* MySQL / PostgreSQL
* Python
* Data analysis
* Data engineering fundamentals
* Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
* Generative AI and AI tools
* APIs and integrations
* Cloud platforms
* Git / GitHub
* Excel and data handling
* Automation
* Web applications and internal tools
* Testing and troubleshooting
* Technical support
* Student assessment platforms
* Learning management and technology solutions



 You are not required to be an expert in all these areas.
 



  





**Build \& Technology** 



* Help build and improve SkillsNCR technology solutions.
* Work on internal tools, dashboards, applications and automation.
* Write and maintain SQL queries.
* Work with databases and datasets.
* Build small applications, scripts and utilities.
* Support integrations between systems and APIs.
* Experiment with AI and Generative AI use cases.
* Assist in developing AI\-enabled learning and assessment solutions.
* Contribute to product enhancements and new features.
* Document technical workflows and solutions.



  





**Testing \& Support** 



* Test new features before release.

* Support students, trainers and internal teams when they face technical problems.
* Maintain issue logs and track resolutions.
* Help improve the reliability and usability of SkillsNCR platforms.
* Work with the team to diagnose and resolve technical issues.



  





**Learning \& Training** 




**As your technical capability develops, you may also:** 



* Help students during practical labs.
* Explain SQL, Python, databases, AI and related topics.
* Create exercises and technical assignments.
* Review student projects.
* Conduct demonstrations and practical sessions.
* Support technical assessments.
* Mentor students on projects and problem solving.



 Teaching responsibilities will depend on your strengths and will grow gradually with your technical experience.
 



  





**Who Should Apply** 




**You may be a good fit if you:** 



* Have completed BCA, MCA, B.Tech, BE or an equivalent technology degree.
* Are a fresher or have no more than 2 years of professional experience.
* Have basic programming knowledge.
* Understand the fundamentals of SQL, databases or software development.
* Are interested in Data, AI, Cloud or software technologies.
* Enjoy solving problems.
* Are comfortable learning new tools independently.
* Can communicate clearly in English and Hindi.
* Are comfortable helping others understand technical concepts.
* Are willing to work full\-time from Gurugram.
* Are comfortable working in an early\-stage startup environment.



  





**What We Value More Than Experience** 




**For this role, we care more about what you can learn and build than the number of years you have worked.** 




**We would like to see things such as:** 



* College projects
* Personal projects
* GitHub repositories
* Python projects
* SQL projects
* Websites or applications you have built
* Data analysis projects
* AI / GenAI experiments
* Automation projects
* Hackathons
* Internships
* Technical presentations



  





 Even a small project is valuable if you can explain:
 



**What problem did you solve?** 




**How did you build it?** 




**What went wrong?** 




**How did you fix it?** 




**You Do Not Need to Know Everything** 




  





**We expect Graduate Trainees to learn.** 




**If we give you a technology you have never used before, we want to see whether you can:** 



1. Understand the fundamentals.
2. Research independently.
3. Build a working solution.
4. Test it.
5. Troubleshoot problems.
6. Document what you did.
7. Explain it to someone else.



 That ability is more important to us than knowing every technology listed in this JD.

* You have more than 2 years of professional experience.
* You are looking primarily for a remote role.
* You only want a teaching job.
* You only want a software development job with no user interaction.
* You are unwilling to work outside one specific technology.
* You prefer theory over hands\-on work.
* You are uncomfortable troubleshooting problems.
* You need detailed instructions for every task.
* You are interested mainly in collecting certifications.



  





**Why Join SkillsNCR** 




**As an early member of the team, you may get exposure to multiple areas instead of being limited to one narrow technology.** 




**You could work on:** 



* Data and databases
* AI and Generative AI
* Internal software platforms
* Student applications
* Automation
* Assessments
* Analytics
* Product testing
* Technical support

title: Trainer - Ortho Robotics - MISSO
description:
Open Locations \-
 



**Delhi, Cochin and Vapi** 




  





 The
 **Trainer – MISSO Orthopedic Robotics** 
 will be responsible for designing, developing, and delivering comprehensive training programs for surgeons, clinical teams, hospital staff, and internal employees on the MISSO Orthopedic Robotic System. The role aims to enhance clinical proficiency, ensure effective adoption of the robotic platform, and build strong product and procedural capabilities across customer and internal teams.
 



  





***Key Responsibilities***




  





***1\. Training Program Design \& Delivery***




*· Develop and deliver structured training programs on the MISSO Orthopedic Robotic System for surgeons, OT staff, and hospital teams.* 




*· Conduct procedure\-specific training covering robot\-assisted orthopedic procedures, particularly knee replacement workflows.* 




*· Deliver hands\-on, simulation\-based, classroom, and virtual training programs for different learner groups.* 




*· Conduct Train\-the\-Trainer programs for internal TAS and Clinical Applications teams to ensure consistent knowledge transfer.* 




*· Provide on\-site training and clinical support during initial procedures and customer onboarding.* 




  





***2\. Internal Employee Training***




*· Conduct product, application, and procedural training for TAS, Service Engineers, and other relevant internal teams.* 




*· Develop structured learning modules to improve product knowledge, clinical understanding, and field readiness.* 




*· Assess employee competency through practical evaluations, simulations, and knowledge assessments.* 




*· Identify capability gaps and conduct refresher and advanced training programs as required.* 




*· Support onboarding and continuous development programs for new MISSO team members.* 




  





***3\. Content Development \& Training Innovation***




*· Develop and maintain training materials, presentations, procedure guides, simulations, and assessment modules.* 




*· Create practical and easy\-to\-understand learning content covering system workflow, surgical planning, robotic application, instrumentation, and troubleshooting.* 




*· Continuously update training content based on product enhancements, field feedback, customer requirements, and clinical developments.* 




*· Introduce interactive and simulation\-based learning methods to improve trainee engagement and competency.* 




  





***4\. Customer \& Cross\-functional Collaboration***




*· Work closely with Clinical Applications, Service, Sales, Product, and Marketing teams to ensure effective customer training and product adoption.* 




*· Coordinate with surgeons and hospital stakeholders to understand training requirements and develop appropriate learning interventions.* 




*· Support customer onboarding and ensure users achieve required competency before independent system utilization.* 




*· Gather customer and field feedback and incorporate relevant insights into future training programs.* 




  





***5\. Measurement \& Evaluation***




*· Conduct Training Needs Analysis (TNA) for customers and internal teams to identify competency and knowledge gaps.* 




*· Evaluate training effectiveness through assessments, practical demonstrations, feedback, and competency evaluations.* 




*· Maintain comprehensive training records, attendance, assessment reports, feedback, and competency trackers.* 




*· Monitor training outcomes and continuously improve training programs based on learner and field feedback.* 




  





***Qualifications \& Experience***




*· Education: Bachelor’s degree in Biomedical Engineering / Life Sciences / Physiotherapy / Nursing / Allied Medical Field. Master’s degree preferred.* 




*· Experience: 3–8 years of experience in clinical applications, customer training, medical devices, orthopedic robotics, surgical navigation, or related medtech domains.* 




*· Experience in orthopedic procedures, knee replacement, robotic\-assisted surgery, or surgical technology will be preferred.* 




*· Prior experience in delivering customer and internal employee training will be an advantage.* 




*· Willingness to travel extensively across India for customer and internal training programs.* 




  





***Key Competencies***




*· Strong understanding of orthopedic surgical workflows and robotic\-assisted procedures.* 




*· Excellent training, facilitation, presentation, and communication skills.* 




*· Strong customer\-facing and stakeholder\-management abilities.* 




*· Ability to conduct effective hands\-on, classroom, and practical training.* 




*· Ability to simplify complex clinical and technical concepts for different audiences.* 




*· Collaborative, adaptable, and field\-oriented professional with a strong learning mindset.*

title: Field Engineer - India
description:
Our mission is to automate coding. The first step in our journey is to build the best tool for professional programmers, using a combination of inventive research, design, and engineering. Our organization is very flat, and our team is small and talent dense. We particularly like people who are truth\-seeking, passionate, and creative. We enjoy spirited debate, crazy ideas, and shipping code.
   

  

****About The Role****
 We’re hiring Field Engineers to partner with prospective and strategic enterprise customers. As a Field Engineer, you’ll be the technical face of Anysphere in the field, helping customers evaluate Cursor, guiding them through proofs of concept, and ensuring they see the full value of AI in their engineering workflows.
   

  

 You’ll work hand\-in\-hand with Sales, Product, and Engineering to scope solutions, demonstrate capabilities, and act as a trusted advisor to technical stakeholders. This is a highly customer\-facing role where you’ll combine deep technical fluency with strong communication skills to drive adoption and influence product direction.
   

  

****What You’ll Do****
* Partner with Account Executives to lead technical discovery, demos, and proof\-of\-concept engagements
* Build trusted relationships with engineering leaders, architects, and developers, serving as their technical advisor
* Translate customer requirements into solution designs, guiding them on best practices for rollout, prompt strategy, and context configuration
* Develop and deliver technical presentations, whiteboard sessions, and hands\-on workshops tailored to customer needs
* Act as the customer’s technical advocate internally, influencing roadmap priorities and escalating feedback to Product and Engineering
* Collaborate with post\-sales teams to ensure a smooth handoff and successful customer onboarding
* Maintain deep knowledge of Cursor’s capabilities and competitive landscape to position our value effectively
* Support strategic account planning and help drive expansion opportunities with technical validation


**You may be a fit if**
* You have strong communication skills and executive presence, equally comfortable coding alongside developers or presenting to CTOs.
* You have a deep understanding of the software development lifecycle, modern engineering org structures, and developer productivity challenges
* You have hands\-on technical ability, and while you don’t need to be a full\-time engineer, but you should be fluent in technical workflows, AI tooling, and debugging complex environments
* You are customer\-obsessed with a knack for translating technical details into business impact
* You have experience in Field Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Pre\-Sales, or Consulting for enterprise software
* You thrive in a startup environment: resourceful, adaptable, and proactive in creating solutions

title: Research Intern :: Gender- Geopolitics
description:

 • Collect and analyze data from various sources to support research initiatives related to geopolitical and strategic issues.
 



 • Conduct in\-depth research and data analysis on the focus areas.

 • Organize, manage, and document research materials to support ongoing projects.
 



 • Provide logistical and administrative support for events, seminars, and workshops.
 



  





 Qualifications and Skills:
 



 • Master’s degree, preferably in Political Science, International Relations or a similar field with a strong focus on gender \& geopolitics.
 



 • Understanding of global power dynamics, regional conflicts, and international political frameworks
 



 • Strong research and analytical skills with attention to detail.
 



 • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
 



 • Proficiency in data analysis tools and research software.
 



 • Proficiency in MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
 



 • Ability to work as part of a team as well as on own initiative.
 



 • Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment.
 



 • Strong interpersonal skills and team ethics.

 **on understanding and improving the product**

* Work closely with the founders on product research, product strategy, feature exploration, and new initiatives.

* Research AI, legal\-tech, SaaS, and software products to understand their features, workflows, UX, capabilities, positioning, and use cases.
* Conduct research across markets, companies, products, competitors, customers, and emerging technologies.
* Analyze competing AI and legal\-tech products across their business models, customers, pricing, funding, features, and market positioning.
* Build structured research databases, competitor matrices, market maps, feature comparisons, and product analyses.
* Speak to or study potential users and customers to better understand their workflows, pain points, behaviors, and requirements.
* Convert research and user insights into product recommendations, feature ideas, strategic briefs, and actionable next steps.
* Analyze information to identify trends, gaps, opportunities, and strategic insights.
* Experiment extensively with AI tools and emerging technologies to understand how they can be incorporated into the product.
* Create clear presentations, spreadsheets, documents, product notes, and strategic briefs.
* Support the founders on high\-priority projects across product, strategy, market intelligence, and business initiatives.


**What We're Looking For**
* Tech / Engineering graduates with 24 years of experience, or MBA graduates with 02 years of experience.
* Strong interest in product, technology, AI, software, and business strategy.
* Strong research, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to understand software products deeply including their features, workflows, user experience, and underlying use cases.
* Highly proficient with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, and similar platforms , and comfortable using AI extensively in everyday work.
* Ability to independently explore and learn unfamiliar industries, technologies, and products quickly.
* Strong written English and the ability to structure and communicate complex information clearly.
* Comfortable working extensively with spreadsheets, presentations, documents, and research tools.
* Curious, detail\-oriented, resourceful, and comfortable taking ownership of open\-ended assignments.
* Comfortably operating in a fast\-moving environment where priorities may evolve as the product and company grow.


**Who This Role Is Best Suited For**
 You are a strong fit for this role if you naturally enjoy:
   

  

* Exploring new AI software products to understand how they work.
* Comparing different products and analyzing why one product performs better than another.
* Breaking down ambiguous problems and designing research approaches to solve them.
* Identifying product improvements, feature gaps, and better user workflows.
* Using AI tools to research, write, prototype, and solve problems faster.
* Turning scattered information into clear, structured insights.


**Growth Progression**
 As the company grows, this role can evolve into broader ownership across
 **product management, product strategy, business strategy, market intelligence, growth, and other high\-priority initiatives,**

 The role offers significant exposure to 0\-to\-1 product building and the opportunity to work closely with the founders on decisions that directly shape the product and company.

**Veeva eQMS Operations \& Administration**
* Serve as the primary business administrator for Veeva eQMS on behalf of Regulatory Quality Assurance.
* Triage and resolve business admin requests requiring business\-level judgment, partnering with technical teams on complex issues.
* Own access request intake and provisioning across RQA’s digital systems environments.
* Support Veeva release coordination through UAT, business approvals and communications, and production deployments.
* Maintain and continuously improve job aids, quick reference guides, and user\-facing documentation for Veeva eQMS and integrated supporting tools, keeping materials current across system releases.
* Develop, prepare, and deliver reporting across functional areas.


**eQMS Systems Expertise \& Advisory**
* Provide guidance on Veeva vault configuration options in support of business needs, including object relationships, shared configuration dependencies, and the downstream impact of proposed changes, partnering with technical teams to fill configuration depth as needed.
* Support the triage and formulation of eQMS enhancement requests, providing business context and impact assessment alongside stakeholder needs and operational impacts to inform prioritization and decision\-making.
* Stay current on Veeva platform developments and GxP digital systems best practices, especially with respect to emerging AI technologies, applying that knowledge to identify and champion opportunities to modernize system design and operations.
* Participate in eQMS governance forums, representing RQA Digital Systems’ interests and staying current on platform developments.


**Cross\-Functional Program Support**
* Independently represent the RQA Digital Systems team within enterprise programs and initiatives requiring digital systems support, scoping team responsibilities, developing execution plans, and delivering against them.
* Maintain clear ownership of workstream status and decisions; proactively surface blockers or escalation points to leadership.
* Coordinate with Pfizer Digital and cross\-functional teams to support enterprise quality data integrity and system continuity efforts.


**Reporting \& Data Operations**
* Issue clear and timely communications, ensuring stakeholders are informed and aligned on timelines and expected outcomes.
* Execute periodic data extracts and reporting tasks, including basic dashboarding and data queries, in support of regulatory and quality operations, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and appropriate documentation.
* Develop and maintain operational documentation and user guidance for current and legacy quality systems to ensure operational continuity.
* Gather, synthesize, and prepare materials for stakeholder communications and leadership briefings, translating system and data insights into accessible formats.


**Transformation \& Continuous Improvement**
* Proactively identify opportunities for meaningful process improvement and digital transformation within RQA’s quality systems operations, bringing both technical grounding and operational context to proposed solutions.
* Apply practical AI knowledge to evaluate use cases, partner with technical teams, and drive adoption of AI\-enabled solutions.
* Contribute to and support broader organizational transformation initiatives, including AI integration into quality workflows, eQMS process redesign, and platform evolution.
* Stay current on Veeva platform capabilities, GxP digital systems trends, and regulatory expectations, applying emerging best practices to improve the team’s operations and delivery.


**QUALIFICATIONS:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Information Systems, Computer Science or a related field with 5\+ years of relevant industry experience; advanced degree preferred.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to produce clear documentation, user\-facing guidance, and stakeholder\-ready reports.
* Demonstrated experience working directly and iteratively with business stakeholders to understand their underlying needs and workflows.
* Working knowledge of Veeva Vault eQMS or a comparable enterprise quality/GxP system, including working knowledge of vault object relationships and configuration dependencies.
* Demonstrated, hands\-on curiosity about AI\-enabled tools, automation, or advanced analytics, with concrete examples of applying them to improve processes and drive innovation.
* Experience in a GxP\-regulated pharmaceutical or biotech environment with demonstrated understanding of quality management system processes.
* Proven ability to operate autonomously and collaboratively on complex, cross\-functional work.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills; able to assess the downstream impact of system changes and translate business needs into actionable decisions.


**Preferred:**
* Basic coding, scripting, and/or dashboarding experience (e.g., SQL, Power BI, Spotfire, or similar).
* Background as a Veeva Vault business administrator, business analyst, or similar business\-technology liaison role.
* Experience with Veeva Vault configuration in a pharma or CRO setting, including participation in system releases, eQMS governance forums, or enhancement request management.
* Familiarity with Pfizer enterprise data and/or source systems.
* Exposure to data platforms – Snowflake, DSS/Dataiku – or related data engineering tools.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Power Automate or similar automation tools.
